serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Cashier.Face.hmmm
Speak of the devil, there she is!
She seems very diligent, mechanical even.
All the noises and people walking nearby don’t seem to faze her even a little, it’s like she’s in her own world, completely separated from the rest.
What’s bothering me the most about this though is why no one else noticed it. 
Maybe for me, who interacts with a sexbot and a priestbot on a daily basis this is something obvious. Maybe other people just don’t care or simply don’t pay mind to the shop’s staff.
Whatever it may be, because of it this cashier has been working here for quite some time already.
#Cashier.Face.normal
Uhh…
I don’t know why, but for some reason she started to look me right in the eye…
Cashier: Excuse me sir, but you have been looking at me for quite some time. Is there a problem?
Shit! How did she notice? Does she have eyes at the back of her head?!
You: O-Oh, sorry. I-I just wanted to take something from the shelf on which you have been putting new things on.
Cashier: …
Cashier: That’s a shelf with tampons and pads…
Fuck!
You: R-Right! My girlfriend wanted me to buy some!
Cashier: Alright then.
She believed it… I’m safe…
Cashier: Next time when I block a shelf with a product you want, please just ask me to move. I wouldn’t want to disturb your shopping.
You: R-Right, got it.
Cashier: Now, if you excuse me…
